title: Hartford v. Carson Madrona
side: Ohio Security and American Fire, moving for partial summary judgment

briefQuote.text: Coverage under the Hartford policy for Carson Madrona does not require proof of liability

skipped.policy: …provided the injury or damage occurs subsequent to the execution of the contract or agreement. … <mark>However, no such person or organization is an insured under this provision if such person or organization is included as an insured by an endorsement issued by us</mark> …
skipped.brief: …provided the injury or damage occurs subsequent to the execution of the contract or agreement. <mark>***</mark> (c) Lessors of Land or Premises…

topAttacks.1: Hartford’s withdrawal letter gave three grounds; the brief answers one
topAttacks.2: The brief quotes the policy but skips the sentence that removes Carson’s status
topAttacks.3: Case law: the endorsement controls the general clause
topAttacks.4: The brief’s no-fault cases involve endorsements that do not allocate by fault
topAttacks.5: The jury found the tenant 0% at fault
topAttacks.6: “Caused, in whole or in part” means proximate cause
